severity_legend.P0: Credential integrity — a critical competency or required skill has zero credential-eligible evidence; badge cannot be honestly issued
severity_legend.P1: Major gap — industry-required skill at one or more in-scope role/levels is not taught at all
severity_legend.P2: Significant improvement — skill is taught but with insufficient depth, isolation, timing, or independence
severity_legend.P3: Enrichment — would improve market readiness but not block credential issuance
severity_legend.P4: Polish — style/consistency, or deliberate out-of-scope items requiring an explicit decision record

note_on_gap_id_numbering: Gap IDs were assigned in drafting order; the ID prefix reflects the original severity intent at the time the gap was first named. Some gaps were re-classified during drafting (e.g., GAP-P1-005 causal_inference and GAP-P1-006 orchestrator_operations were downgraded P1->P2; GAP-P1-009 ambiguity and GAP-P1-011 communication-timing were downgraded P1->P2; GAP-P2-012 CONTINUE-pattern and GAP-P2-013 TE-external were downgraded P2->P3). Always consult the 'severity' field for the authoritative classification. summary_counts reflects the authoritative severity field.

deliberate_omissions_python_first_scope.rationale: PyArcana is Python-only by design; R is the alternative-stats language. Out of scope but should be acknowledged on the DS badge as 'not covered'.

PyArcana uses pandas + openpyxl instead of in-Excel pivot/INDEX-MATCH. S20 covers Excel automation via openpyxl. The DA badge should disclose 'Excel-as-analyst-tool not covered; Excel-as-automation-target covered in S20'.

PyArcana uses Playwright/Selenium (python_rpa_browser) instead of UiPath Studio. Durable principles (selectors, exception handling, state machines, dispatcher/performer) ARE in scope; vendor UI is not.
VB.NET/C# is the UiPath coded-automation language. PyArcana's RPA track is Python-only. Out of scope.
Microsoft Power Automate is a separate vendor platform. PyArcana covers the durable patterns (Python + browser automation); the Microsoft stack is out of scope.
Automation Anywhere A360 is a separate vendor platform. Out of scope for the same reason as Power Automate.

gaps.title: leakage_prevention never taught as a named, assessed skill
market_evidence: industry_reality_brief.md §3.5 — 'Data leakage and invalid evaluation' (HIGH confidence; IBM Think, H2O Wiki, Kaggle Alexis Cook, O*NET 15-2051 Tasks 5 & 15)
industry_skill_graph.json critical_competency 'leakage_prevention' — non-compensatory for DS and AIML
role_skill_taxonomy.json: required at data_scientist/independent+, ai_ml_engineer/independent+
gaps.current_pyarcana_coverage: Implicit only — S10 (sklearn) teaches train/test split mechanics; S33 (advanced-models) teaches cross-validation; S39 integrator touches 'features sin leakage de labels futuros' in one sentence. No section names leakage as a concept, no activity requires the learner to identify or prevent target/train-test/time/group/label leakage.
gaps.exact_section_and_insertion_point: S10 (sklearn) — add a new theory block 'T5-A Leakage taxonomy' + I Do demo + We Do E1/E2/E3. Reinforce in S33 (advanced-models) with a 'leakage hunt' exercise and in S39 integrator-phase2 with an independent 'audit this pipeline for leakage' You Do sub-task.
gaps.proposed_content_type: New theory block + 3 new We Do exercises (E1 guided leakage-hunt, E2 independent fix, E3 transfer to a new dataset) + You Do extension in S39 that requires the learner to identify and patch a planted leakage bug.
gaps.learner_outcome: Learner can name the 5 leakage modes (target, train-test contamination, time-series, group, label), identify them in a foreign pipeline, and write a leakage-prevention test that fails on contamination.
gaps.assessment_method: Independent performance task: given a pre-written pipeline with planted leakage, learner must (a) identify the leakage mode, (b) write a regression test that reproduces it, (c) patch the pipeline so the test passes. Server-graded via test runner (not MCQ).
gaps.backward_compatibility_impact: Additive — new theory block + new exercises inserted under existing S10 subtopic structure; does not renumber or rename any existing activity. S39 You Do gains an optional 4th objective; existing 5 objectives remain.
gaps.credential_impact: Without this gap closed, the DS Independent, DS Advanced, DS Leadership, AIML Independent, AIML Advanced, AIML Leadership badges cannot be honestly issued — leakage_prevention is non-compensatory.

gaps.title: Critical-competency credential-eligible evidence count is dangerously thin for several competencies
market_evidence: curriculum_skill_graph.json#summary.credential_eligible_activities = 104 (49 you_do + 3 capstone + 52 exam) across 52 sections

Per competency: leakage_prevention=2 (both from model_evaluation in S10; leakage_prevention itself has 0), selector_resilience=6, sql_competency=6 (none from sql_performance_tuning), type_safety_production_hardening=20 (none from python_type_safety)
affected_role_and_level: all roles at independent+ — every badge depends on at least one critical competency
gaps.current_pyarcana_coverage: Critical-competency credential-eligible activities per competency range from 2 to 24. With the per-section exam being the same exam activity re-used across the competency's skills, the evidence is concentrated in 1–3 sections per competency.
gaps.exact_section_and_insertion_point: Cross-cutting — see GAP-P0-001 to GAP-P0-004 for the per-competency insertions. Additionally, ensure each critical competency has ≥2 distinct credential-eligible activities from ≥2 distinct sections before any badge rubric cites it.
gaps.proposed_content_type: For each critical competency, ensure ≥2 sections contribute ≥1 credential-eligible activity each. Currently mlops_fluency, communication, reproducibility, business_framing meet this bar; sql_competency, leakage_prevention, selector_resilience, type_safety do not.
gaps.learner_outcome: Each critical competency is evidenced by performance across at least 2 distinct contexts, reducing the risk that a single accidentally-easy activity inflates a badge.
gaps.assessment_method: Static check on the curriculum graph: for each critical competency, assert |{sections contributing cred-eligible activities}| ≥ 2.
gaps.backward_compatibility_impact: Additive — only adds activities; never removes.
gaps.credential_impact: Without the ≥2-section bar, badge issuance is one-section-deep for 4 of 8 critical competencies.
